description: This file defines internal parsing logic for format strings in the Abseil C++ library, including classes and functions for parsing, representing, and validating format strings and conversions.

classes.name: ParsedFormatBase
classes.description: Represents a parsed format string, providing methods to process and validate format items.

classes.name: ExtendedParsedFormat
classes.description: A template class for extended format string parsing supporting multiple conversion characters, with runtime and compile-time checks.

methods.name: ParseFormatString
methods.description: Parses a format string and passes items to a consumer, handling text and conversion specifiers.

methods.name: EnsureConstexpr
methods.description: Checks if a string_view is a constexpr string.

methods.name: ParsedFormatBase::ProcessFormat
methods.description: Processes the parsed format with a consumer, applying conversions and appending text.

methods.name: ExtendedParsedFormat::New
methods.description: Factory method to create an extended parsed format with runtime checking.

methods.name: ExtendedParsedFormat::NewAllowIgnored
methods.description: Factory method to create an extended parsed format allowing ignored arguments.
